status: First implementation review; fix before release

findings.problem: 468pt advertising hero plus existing role/header pushes every active object action below the first screen. This repeats the semantic problem.
findings.request: Make the first viewport useful: compact editorial image around 220–250pt or combine it with active object and a working primary CTA. Visible project identity and next action on entry. Long workflow can follow. Preserve visual breathing room rather than cramming everything.

findings.problem: Technical step is marked done whenever product executions resolve, even when no documents or models exist.
findings.request: Do not equate choosing products with completing a technical package. Reflect actual file availability as available/partial/by request, never done for zero assets. Add a meaningful zero-document case.

findings.problem: Client is optional when creating a project, but next action requires it before proposal. This is inconsistent.
findings.request: Keep client optional throughout. Offer edit identity as a secondary action, not a gate to generating a proposal.

findings.problem: Product cards deduplicate by product ID, so multiple chosen executions/colours disappear. Material Studio entry carries finish but not selected RAL.
findings.request: Show each distinct selected execution/colour, use line ID for accessibility and pass the actual chosen colour into material viewing. If color cannot be represented state that precisely, do not imply white is the selected finish.

findings.problem: Fixed 412pt cards may clip two actions and multiline metadata. Club copy repeatedly talks about missing app functions/backend and unverified absence of terms.
findings.request: Use sizing that survives long labels/Dynamic Type. Club copy should explain actual benefits and a short official-site handoff, not implementation caveats. Remove speculative 'terms not published'. Designer tab should be 'Проекты' to match the object workflow; specification remains inside.

accepted: Official logo rendering is visually correct in the new PNG
Use of original Soft SVG assets with provenance
ProjectStore reuse and proposal version tracking direction
